query documentSearch(
  $query: String!
  $orFilters: [AndFilterInput!]
  $count: Int!
  $start: Int!
  $viewUrn: String
) {
  searchAcrossEntities(
    input: {
      query: $query
      count: $count
      start: $start
      types: [DOCUMENT]
      orFilters: $orFilters
      viewUrn: $viewUrn
      searchFlags: { skipHighlighting: true, maxAggValues: 10 }
    }
  ) {
    start
    count
    total
    searchResults {
      entity {
        ... on Document {
          ...DocumentSearchInfo
        }
      }
    }
    facets {
      field
      displayName
      aggregations {
        value
        count
        displayName
        entity {
          ...DocumentFacetEntityInfo
        }
      }
    }
  }

query GetEntityLineage($input: SearchAcrossLineageInput!) {
    searchAcrossLineage(input: $input) {
        total
        facets {
            field
            displayName
            aggregations {
                value
                count
                entity {
                    urn
                }
            }
        }
        searchResults {
            entity {
                urn
                type
                ...entityPreview
            }
            paths {
                path {
                    urn
                    type
                    ... on SchemaFieldEntity {
                        fieldPath
                        parent {
                            urn
                            type
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            degree
        }
    }

            paths {
                path {
                    urn
                    type
                    ... on SchemaFieldEntity {
                        fieldPath
                        parent {
                            urn
                            type
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            degree
        }
    }
